support_services.evidence: Undergraduate students’ insurance is financially supported by UNIST.
Once you are accepted to a UNIST study program, the UNIST admission team will issue a package of visa documents and send it to you.
International students are required to receive prior permission from the immigration office before they engage in the unauthorized activities such as part-time job.

conflicts.detail: Scholarships page says the 75,000 KRW/month NHI refund applies to 'All undergraduate students'; International Affairs Team page limits reimbursement to 'Only Regular Undergraduate Students-No exchange, GKS, Graduate students'.

gaps: No minimum English test scores are published for undergraduate or graduate admission (guides list accepted tests only).
Undergraduate guide names 'TOEFL' and 'IELTS' without format (iBT/Academic), so they are recorded as OTHER.
